title: Autumn in the Park
text:
It is autumn now. The leaves on the trees are yellow and red. Tom and his mum go to the park.

There is a big playground in the park. Tom plays on the slide and the swings. It is cold, so Tom wears a red hat.

questions.text: Why does Tom wear a hat in the park?
How does Tom probably feel in the park?

vocabulary.definition: the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees
an outdoor area with equipment for children to play on
a smooth, sloping structure that children go down

paragraph_translations: Teraz jest jesień. Liście na drzewach są żółte i czerwone. Tomek i jego mama idą do parku.
W parku jest duży plac zabaw. Tomek bawi się na zjeżdżalni i na huśtawkach. Jest zimno, więc Tomek ma czerwoną czapkę.
